; Private appended opcode 854. Result is 0 on refusal/failure, 1 on success.
.macro EnsureRoute101Actors result
.short 854
.short \result
.endm

ScrDef Route101_OnLoad
ScrDef Route101_Gate
ScrDef Route101_Failure
ScrDef Route101_Bag
ScrDef Route101_Birch
ScrDef Route101_Zigzagoon

WaitABPress
CloseMsg
// Receipt is already committed. Naming never grants or retries the gift.
TouchscreenMenuHide
NPCMsg 21
GetMenuChoice VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT
CloseMsg
Compare VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT, 0
GoToIfNe HoennReward_PartyDone
// GiveMonToPartyOrPC appended this mon; NicknameInput takes a party index.
GetPartyCount VAR_TEMP_x4000
SubVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 1
FadeScreen 6, 1, 0, RGB_BLACK
WaitFade
NicknameInput VAR_TEMP_x4000, VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT
FadeScreen 6, 1, 1, RGB_BLACK
WaitFade
HoennReward_PartyDone:
TouchscreenMenuShow
ReleaseAll
End

// PRIVATE appended Route 101 entries. Persistent state: 416e only.
// 4000 is a one-shot frame latch, NEVER the persistent phase predicate.
// Native 374 SHOWS; MakeObjectVisible HIDES. Hiding does not disable collision.
Route101_OnLoad:
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 0
EnsureRoute101Actors VAR_TEMP_x4003
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_LoadFailed
Compare VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 2
GoToIfNe Route101_LoadRepair
SetVar VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 3
Route101_LoadRepair:
Call Route101_RepairPresent
GetPlayerCoords VAR_TEMP_x4001, VAR_TEMP_x4002
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4001, 10
GoToIfEq Route101_LoadLane
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4001, 11
GoToIfNe Route101_End
Route101_LoadLane:
Compare VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 0
GoToIfEq Route101_LoadUnstarted
Compare VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 3
GoToIfNe Route101_End
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4002, 18
GoToIfEq Route101_Arm18
End
Route101_LoadUnstarted:
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4002, 19
GoToIfEq Route101_Arm19
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4002, 18
GoToIfEq Route101_Arm18
End
Route101_Arm19:
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 1
End
Route101_Arm18:
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 2
End
Route101_LoadFailed:
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 3
End

// Shared frame/coordinate entry: clear BEFORE any yield or conditional exit.
Route101_Gate:
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 0
GetPlayerCoords VAR_TEMP_x4001, VAR_TEMP_x4002
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4001, 10
GoToIfEq Route101_GateLane
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4001, 11
GoToIfNe Route101_End
Route101_GateLane:
Compare VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 0
GoToIfEq Route101_GateZero
Compare VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 3
GoToIfNe Route101_End
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4002, 18
GoToIfNe Route101_End
EnsureRoute101Actors VAR_TEMP_x4003
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_Failure
LockAll
NPCMsg 19
WaitABPress
CloseMsg
ApplyMovement obj_player, Route101_Move_Up
WaitMovement
ReleaseAll
End
Route101_GateZero:
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4002, 18
GoToIfEq Route101_GateZeroReady
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4002, 19
GoToIfNe Route101_End
Route101_GateZeroReady:
EnsureRoute101Actors VAR_TEMP_x4003
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_Failure
LockAll
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4002, 19
GoToIfEq Route101_StartLocked
ApplyMovement obj_player, Route101_Move_Down
WaitMovement
// Scripted movements need not dispatch coordinate callbacks. Call directly.
GetPlayerCoords VAR_TEMP_x4001, VAR_TEMP_x4002
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4002, 19
GoToIfNe Route101_FailureLocked
Route101_StartLocked:
// 339's encoded order is object,x,HEIGHT,z,facing, despite macro arg names.
MovePersonFacing 0, 9, 0, 13, DIR_EAST
MovePersonFacing 1, 10, 0, 13, DIR_WEST
MovePersonFacing 2, 7, 0, 14, DIR_SOUTH
ScrCmd_374 0
ScrCmd_374 1
ScrCmd_374 2
ApplyMovement 0, Route101_Move_BirchPause
ApplyMovement 1, Route101_Move_ZigzagoonPrime
ApplyMovement 2, Route101_Move_BagPrime
WaitMovement
NPCMsg 17
WaitABPress
CloseMsg
MovePersonFacing 0, 0, 0, 15, DIR_EAST
MovePersonFacing 1, 0, 0, 16, DIR_NORTH
ApplyMovement obj_player, Route101_Move_EnterScene
ApplyMovement 0, Route101_Move_BirchRunAway1
ApplyMovement 1, Route101_Move_ZigzagoonChase1
WaitMovement
ApplyMovement 1, Route101_Move_ZigzagoonChaseInCircles
ApplyMovement 0, Route101_Move_BirchRunInCircles
WaitMovement
ApplyMovement 0, Route101_Move_BirchPause
WaitMovement
ApplyMovement 1, Route101_Move_ZigzagoonFaceBirch
ApplyMovement 0, Route101_Move_BirchFaceZigzagoon
WaitMovement
NPCMsg 18
WaitABPress
CloseMsg
SetVar VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 3
ReleaseAll
End

Route101_Failure:
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 0
LockAll
Route101_FailureLocked:
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 0
NPCMsg 20
WaitABPress
CloseMsg
ReleaseAll
End

// Synchronous subroutine. Caller has checked ensure; no actor queries on failure.
Route101_RepairPresent:
Compare VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 3
GoToIfEq Route101_RestoreFinal
MakeObjectVisible 0
MakeObjectVisible 1
MakeObjectVisible 2
MovePersonFacing 0, 0, 0, 0, DIR_EAST
MovePersonFacing 1, 1, 0, 0, DIR_WEST
MovePersonFacing 2, 2, 0, 0, DIR_SOUTH
Return
Route101_RestoreFinal:
MovePersonFacing 0, 4, 0, 13, DIR_EAST
MovePersonFacing 1, 5, 0, 13, DIR_WEST
MovePersonFacing 2, 7, 0, 14, DIR_SOUTH
ScrCmd_374 0
ScrCmd_374 1
ScrCmd_374 2
Return

// Separate entry: never Call old entry2, whose exits are End, not Return.
Route101_Bag:
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 0
Compare VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 3
GoToIfNe Route101_End
EnsureRoute101Actors VAR_TEMP_x4003
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_Failure
LockAll
FacePlayer
SetVar VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, HOENN_RESCUE_NOT_STARTED
TouchscreenMenuHide
NPCMsg 11
MenuInit 1, 1, 0, 1, VAR_SPECIAL_x8000
MenuItemAdd 12, 255, 1
MenuItemAdd 13, 255, 0
MenuExec
TouchscreenMenuShow
CloseMsg
Compare VAR_SPECIAL_x8000, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_BagCancel
SetVar VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, HOENN_RESCUE_IN_PROGRESS
WildBattle SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON, 2, 0
// Live battle OnLoad may normalize 2->3; it NEVER writes the native result.
GetStaticEncounterOutcome VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT
SetVar VAR_TEMP_x4000, 0
Compare VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT, BATTLE_OUTCOME_WIN
GoToIfEq Route101_Victory
Compare VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT, BATTLE_OUTCOME_MON_CAUGHT
GoToIfEq Route101_Victory
SetVar VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, HOENN_RESCUE_NOT_STARTED
// Keep result intact through the synchronous repair attempt.
EnsureRoute101Actors VAR_TEMP_x4003
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
CallIfEq Route101_RepairPresent
Compare VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT, BATTLE_OUTCOME_LOSE
GoToIfEq Route101_Blackout
Compare VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT, BATTLE_OUTCOME_DRAW
GoToIfEq Route101_Blackout
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_FailureLocked
NPCMsg 15
GoTo Route101_Close
Route101_Victory:
SetVar VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, HOENN_RESCUE_COMPLETE
EnsureRoute101Actors VAR_TEMP_x4003
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_FailureLocked
Call Route101_RepairPresent
// Keep Birch visible for his thanks, then let him leave for the lab.
// The encounter and bag remain hidden; no health or outcome is changed.
MovePersonFacing 0, 4, 0, 13, DIR_EAST
ScrCmd_374 0
ApplyMovement 0, Route101_Move_BirchPause
WaitMovement
NPCMsg 14
WaitABPress
CloseMsg
Call Route101_RepairPresent
ReleaseAll
End
Route101_BagCancel:
SetVar VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, HOENN_RESCUE_NOT_STARTED
EnsureRoute101Actors VAR_TEMP_x4003
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_FailureLocked
Call Route101_RepairPresent
ReleaseAll
End
Route101_Blackout:
// OnLoad failure must not replace a natural loss/draw with a nonblackout.
WhiteOut
ReleaseAll
End

Route101_Birch:
Compare VAR_HOENN_RESCUE_STATE, 3
GoToIfNe Route101_End
EnsureRoute101Actors VAR_TEMP_x4003
Compare VAR_TEMP_x4003, 1
GoToIfNe Route101_Failure
LockAll
NPCMsg 18
Route101_Close:
WaitABPress
CloseMsg
ReleaseAll
Route101_End:
End

Route101_Zigzagoon:
// Interaction is defined, but the bag is the only battle caller.
End
